Maya Chen: Morning team — quick async standup. Drop a 1-liner (yesterday / blocker / today). I'll start: shipped prefix-KV cache fix to staging, rolled back one noisy test. Blocker: can't repro higher latency locally. Today: start canary for routing v2.

Alex Rivera: Shipped: PR #482 (routing v2 canary) merged to canary. Observed ~12% latency tail on batch=8 in scale test. Blocker: need @Samir to check infra metrics, might be GPU mem spilling. PTAL @Jordan for post-merge smoke.

Samir Patel: Looking. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/metrics/987 — saw GPU mem jitter around 02:10 UTC. Will run a repro with the same load profile. ETA 45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Jordan Lee: PTAL on PR in 20m. Also there's a small config mismatch in canary policy: timeout=2s vs expected 3s. Pushed fix to canary branch, will watch.

Taylor Nguyen: Blocker: dedicated capacity procurement stuck — quota request pending approval. @ops-bot can you surface the cloud tickets?

ops-bot: Quota increase request created: ticket #INC-1872. Assigned to cloud-team. Current ETA ~2 hours. Notifying @Taylor Nguyen when approved.

Alex Rivera: FYI deploy-bot: canary rollout started 09:12 UTC. Keeping an eye on 95/99th percentiles. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: Canary 1/3 deployed to us-east-1a. Health: passing. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/canary/1762509999

Maya Chen: Awesome — if anyone needs review help call it out. Low-priority ask: can reviewers prioritize CRs from infra team (they're on critical path). I'll send a follow-up thread with PR list. :memo: 

Jordan Lee: LGTM on my review, left one minor comment. Will re-check after Samir's metrics.

Samir Patel: Repro run started. Early signal: memory creep consistent with extra KV entries. Trying a small patch to free cache sooner.

Taylor Nguyen: Thanks @ops-bot — I'll prep communications for customer-facing teams if the quota delay persists.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If anything degrades, tag #incidents and ping on-call. End of checks.
